execution.implementation: Genuine Rosalind task-chooser observation plus CID-exact PubChem evidence and deterministic local ACE-inhibitor descriptor and ionization review

observations: PubChem records report XLogP values of 0.3, -0.1, and -2.9 for captopril, enalapril, and lisinopril.
The retained pKa annotations are 3.7/9.8, 3.0/5.4, and 2.5/4.0/6.7/10.1, respectively.
The local descriptor table was reproduced with RDKit 2026.03.5.
A genuine mcp__rosalind__rosalind_open call returned the retained ready response for this case-specific context.
interpretation: The structures span different polarity and ionization regimes; computed descriptors organize chemical hypotheses without quantifying plasma LogD or clinical absorption.
limitations: PubChem XLogP and RDKit MolLogP are computed descriptors, not clinical ADME measurements.
A uniform experimental LogD at pH 7.4 was not available for all three retained records.
Macro-pKa annotations do not uniquely specify every microspecies in a multi-ionizable compound.
The Rosalind operation opened only the task chooser; no Rosalind scientific job or laboratory experiment was executed.

provenance.note: The launcher observation records the exact Rosalind chooser response and does not represent scientific execution. Exact public compound records feed a retained local script; the resulting tables distinguish source annotations from computed descriptors.

reproduction: Run python showcases/rosalind-workbench/cases/rosalind-ace-logd-pka/scripts/analyze.py from the repository root.
Invoke mcp__rosalind__rosalind_open with task_context ACE inhibitor ionization and lipophilicity teaching case, then compare the response with outputs/rosalind-open-observation.json.
Compare the three output files and SVG preview with the retained artifacts.
